title: anim.mediumwind/1
description: data/anim/medium_wind.json: Combat's eight rules for a medium thrown on Y's 12-tick wind-up (docs/combat/pending/movegen/parts.json strike.windup), as the body does them (docs/animation/super-heavy.md section 3). Render only, outside the sim's data hash; used only with RenderAnim.press_styles and RenderAnim.medium_wind, on the medium press style with a wind-up of 14 ticks or fewer. rules: per rule id (w4 to w8), u_cap (the chamber is reached this far at most, 0 to 1) and step (the share of the key set's step the body takes, 0 to 1). sets: key set id to its rule (generated by render/anim/tools/medium_wind_gen.mjs from the moveset rows). held_only: key sets whose rule is w1 to w3, which only play on a held Y and carry no change here. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every key of sets and every held_only entry is a key set of a wave; every value of sets is a key of rules) are for tools/lib/xref-fight.js.

u_cap.description: The chamber is reached this far at most (a flatter wind-up).

step.description: The share of the key set's step the body takes (a half step is 0.5).

sets.description: Key set id to the rule that it follows.

held_only.description: Key set ids of the held-only mediums (rule w1 to w3).
